# Berchtesgaden National Park

## Germany’s Only Alpine National Park

![Logo IUCN](https://www.nationalpark-berchtesgaden.bayern.de/natur/auszeichnungen/iucn/IUCN_4c.png)

»National park recognition according to the guidelines of the World Conservation Union (IUCN)«

## Do's and Don'ts Around the National Park’s –    Code of Conduct

Our rangers are particularly challenged. Violations of the National Park Ordinance happen almost every day in all areas. Help to protect the sensitive mountain nature! Please follow the rules during your visit.

[Our Code of Conduct](https://www.nationalpark-berchtesgaden.bayern.de/english/adventure/rules_notes/behavior_rules/index.htm "Our rules of conduct")
